items.title: Police investigating David Walliams over reports alleging serious sexual offences
items.summary: The Met Police said the allegations are separate from those reported by ITV and the Guardian earlier this week.

items.title: US Air Force says it responded to 'suspected drones' over RAF Lakenheath
items.summary: The American military says there were no injuries or damage after "suspected unauthorised drone activity" this evening.

items.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
items.summary: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.

items.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
items.summary: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.

items.title: Former Hamas bodyguard guilty of UK knife attack
items.summary: Mohammed Alfatih was granted asylum in the UK in 2015 and British citizenship in 2020.

items.title: New campaign against EU membership launches ahead of UK-EU summit
items.summary: The launch of Stay Out comes as Andy Burnham prepares for talks with European leaders next week.

items.title: Watch: BBC undercover reporter is offered fake art and awards for talent visa
items.summary: Companies are offering to help migrants pose as talented artists to make fraudulent UK visa applications, the BBC has found.

items.title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online
items.summary: Bilal Kazi targeted his victims - aged between 10 and 17 - using Snapchat, Wink and Roblox.
